claims.text: Failure modes / partial failure (finding 1): a recorded pack_written followed by a failed signed_off append is repairable. The next sign-off, from the same or a fresh preview with the same snapshot, checks the pack's files against the hashes the pack_written entry recorded and appends the signed_off entry evidence.json already carries. It never rewrites the pack. It is refused under any other typed name, or when the files changed or the folder is gone.

claims.text: Idempotency: a second sign-off of a signed snapshot is refused and the pack is never overwritten. A folder already at packs/<snapshot> that the log does not record is refused and never removed. Finishing a sign-off whose entry was not recorded appends exactly once, and a further attempt is refused as already signed off.

Partial failure: the pack is staged in packs/.part-*, fsynced and renamed. A crash at the rename leaves no pack, and the next taken sign-off removes leftovers. A refused sign-off leaves leftovers untouched. If the log refuses the pack_written append, the pack is removed so no pack sits without its entry.

dispositions.finding: verify-251 finding 1 (major, R42): a failed signed_off append after a recorded pack_written leaves the snapshot permanently unsignable
dispositions.evidence: At 236f5c1, pack.sign_off routes a snapshot whose pack_written entry exists and whose signed_off entry does not to _complete (src/cma/pack.py). _complete verifies the files against the recorded hashes and appends the evidence.json sign-off. test_r42_a_sign_off_entry_not_recorded_can_be_recorded_again injects SaveNotRecorded on the second append and re-signs from a fresh preview with the same snapshot, through pack.sign_off and the CLI (exit 4, then exit 0 'now recorded'). It passes, and the log verifies intact.

notes: No code changed in this pass; the producer's 236f5c1 already answers finding 1, and the evidence above re-proves it. Gaps for the owner, none of which needs code within scope. (1) _complete records the pack's original sign-off even when the case has changed since. It records what was signed at that snapshot, but R23's 'stale' refusal does not apply on that path, and the owner should confirm that reading. (2) _complete compares only the files the pack_written entry hashed, so an extra file added to packs/<snapshot> is not detected. (3) If the pack_written append answers SaveNotConfirmed, the pack is kept. If its entry is not in fact in the log, the next sign-off is refused with 'move that folder aside', a manual step. (4) The P15/Windows lock path is still covered only by Rollout step 3, not CI.
